reviewMethod: Direct visual reading of all four extracted cells at their displayed normal pet scale; compared identity and lower-body proportions against canonical base inspected in standard review.

cardinals.label: up
cardinals.landmarks: Face tipped upward, both pupils directed toward upper eye area, raised chin and longer exposed neck beneath jaw. Full frontal shoulders and stable feet.

cardinals.label: right
cardinals.landmarks: Nose and face project toward screen right, visible ear on screen-left side of face, gaze at right edge; hair masses trail predominantly left. Direction readable from profile silhouette at normal scale.

cardinals.label: down
cardinals.landmarks: Head bowed, eyelids/pupils lower, forehead and top of head dominate while chin approaches collar. Clearly distinct from upward anchor.

cardinals.label: left
cardinals.landmarks: Nose and face project toward screen left, visible ear on screen-right side of face, gaze at left edge; hair masses trail predominantly right. Opposite profile to 90 degrees, readable at normal scale.

identity: All four retain teal wavy hair, green eyes, tan uniform, thin red bow, white collar/cuffs, dark knee socks and brown shoes.
lowerBody: Skirt, exposed knees, sock lengths, shoe sizes and planted feet remain visually stable across anchors. No obvious lower-body rescale or clipping.
limitations: Pre-despill magenta edge pixels excluded. This report verifies cardinal semantics visually, not alpha cleanup or interpolated look frames.
